feats.name: Alert
feats.description: Always on the lookout for danger, you gain the following benefits:

benefits.name: Initiative Proficiency
benefits.description: When you roll Initiative, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll.

benefits.name: Initiative Swap
benefits.description: Immediately after you roll Initiative, you can swap your Initiative with the Initiative of one willing ally in the same combat. You can't make this swap if you or the ally has the Incapacitated condition.

feats.name: Crafter
feats.description: You are adept at crafting and commerce, gaining the following benefits:

benefits.name: Tool Proficiency
benefits.description: You gain proficiency with three different Artisan's Tools of your choice.

benefits.name: Discount
benefits.description: Whenever you buy a nonmagical item, you receive a 20 percent discount on it.

benefits.name: Fast Crafting
benefits.description: When you finish a Long Rest, you can craft one piece of gear from the Fast Crafting table. The item lasts until you finish another Long Rest.

feats.name: Healer
feats.description: You have the training and intuition to administer first aid, gaining the following benefits:

benefits.name: Battle Medic
benefits.description: Expend one use of a Healer's Kit to tend to a creature within 5ft. They can expend a Hit Die; they regain HP equal to the roll + your Proficiency Bonus.

benefits.name: Healing Rerolls
benefits.description: Whenever you roll a 1 to determine HP restored with a spell or Battle Medic, you can reroll it once.

feats.name: Lucky
feats.description: You have inexplicable luck that kicks in at just the right moment, gaining the following benefits:

benefits.name: Luck Points
benefits.description: You have Luck Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

benefits.name: Advantage
benefits.description: Spend 1 Luck Point to give yourself Advantage on a D20 Test.

benefits.name: Disadvantage
benefits.description: Spend 1 Luck Point to impose Disadvantage on an attack roll against you.

feats.name: Magic Initiate
feats.description: You have learned the basics of magic, gaining the following benefits:

benefits.name: Two Cantrips
benefits.description: Learn two cantrips from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard list.

benefits.name: Level 1 Spell
benefits.description: Learn one level 1 spell from the same list. Cast once per Long Rest for free, or using slots.

benefits.name: Spell Change
benefits.description: When you level up, you can swap one of these spells for another of the same level.

feats.name: Musician
feats.description: You are a practiced musician, gaining the following benefits:

benefits.name: Instrument Training
benefits.description: You gain proficiency with three Musical Instruments of your choice.

benefits.name: Encouraging Song
benefits.description: Give Heroic Inspiration to allies after a rest. Number of allies affected equals your Proficiency Bonus.

feats.name: Savage Attacker
feats.description: You've trained to deal particularly damaging strikes. Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.

benefits.name: Reroll Damage
benefits.description: Once per turn, roll weapon damage twice and use either roll.

feats.name: Sharp Eye
feats.description: You have a keen eye for detail, gaining the following benefits:

benefits.name: Keen Observation
benefits.description: Give yourself Advantage on a Search or Study action. If the check fails, the use isn't expended.

feats.name: Skilled
feats.description: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

benefits.name: Proficiencies
benefits.description: Gain three skill or tool proficiencies.

feats.name: Survivor
feats.description: You are a master of staying alive, gaining the following benefits:

benefits.name: Hypervigilance
benefits.description: When you roll 9 or lower on Initiative, you can reroll and must use the new roll.

benefits.name: Steel Yourself
benefits.description: When you fail a save vs Charmed or Frightened, use a Reaction to add your PB to the roll.

feats.name: Tavern Brawler
feats.description: You are adept at using everything around you as a weapon, gaining the following benefits:

benefits.name: Enhanced Unarmed Strike
benefits.description: Unarmed Strike damage becomes 1d4 + Str modifier.

benefits.name: Damage Rerolls
benefits.description: Reroll 1s on Unarmed Strike damage dice.

benefits.name: Improvised Weaponry
benefits.description: Gain proficiency with improvised weapons.

benefits.name: Push
benefits.description: Once per turn when hitting with an Unarmed Strike (Attack action), deal damage and push the target 5ft.

feats.name: Tough
feats.description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your character level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a character level thereafter, your Hit Point maximum increases by an additional 2 Hit Points.

benefits.name: HP Increase
benefits.description: HP max increases by 2 x Level. Gain +2 HP max each level thereafter.

feats.name: Ability Score Improvement
feats.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. This feat can't increase an ability score above 20.

benefits.name: Stat Increase
benefits.description: Increase one score by 2 or two by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Charisma score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Impersonation
benefits.description: While disguised, have Advantage on Deception or Performance checks to convince others you are that person.

benefits.name: Mimicry
benefits.description: Mimic sounds and speech. Creatures must succeed on an Insight check to detect it is fake.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Climb Speed
benefits.description: You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

benefits.name: Hop Up
benefits.description: Stand up from Prone with only 5 feet of movement.

benefits.name: Jumping
benefits.description: Make a running Long or High Jump after moving only 5 feet.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Improved Dash
benefits.description: When you take the Dash action, your Speed increases by 10 feet for that action.

benefits.name: Charge Attack
benefits.description: If you move 10ft in a straight line before hitting with a melee attack (Attack action), choose: +1d8 damage or push the target 10ft (if Large or smaller).

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Constitution or Wisdom score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Cook's Utensils
benefits.description: You gain proficiency with Cook's Utensils.

benefits.name: Replenishing Meal
benefits.description: Cook food for up to 4 + PB creatures. Those who eat and spend Hit Dice regain an extra 1d8 HP.

benefits.name: Bolstering Treats
benefits.description: Craft PB treats (last 8 hours). Eating one as a Bonus Action grants Temp HP equal to your PB.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Dexterity score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Ignore Loading
benefits.description: Ignore the Loading property of crossbows. You can load a crossbow even if you lack a free hand.

benefits.name: Firing in Melee
benefits.description: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose Disadvantage on attack rolls with crossbows.

benefits.name: Dual Wielding
benefits.description: Add your ability modifier to the damage of the extra attack from the Light property when using a light crossbow.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Push
benefits.description: Once per turn, move a creature hit by bludgeoning damage 5ft (if Large or smaller).

benefits.name: Enhanced Critical
benefits.description: When you score a critical hit with bludgeoning damage, attack rolls against that creature have Advantage until your next turn.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Dexterity score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Parry
benefits.description: If holding a Finesse weapon and hit by a melee attack, use a Reaction to add your PB to your AC until the start of your next turn.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Enhanced Dual Wielding
benefits.description: When you attack with a Light weapon, you can make an extra attack as a Bonus Action with a different melee weapon that lacks the Two-Handed property.

benefits.name: Quick Draw
benefits.description: You can draw or stow two non-Two-Handed weapons instead of one.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Constitution score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Defy Death
benefits.description: You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws.

benefits.name: Speedy Recovery
benefits.description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one of your Hit Point Dice, roll the die, and regain a number of Hit Points equal to the roll.

feats.name: Elemental Adept
feats.prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Energy Mastery
benefits.description: Spells you cast ignore Resistance to damage of the chosen type. In addition, when you roll damage for a spell you cast that deals damage of that type, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2.

feats.name: Fey Touched
feats.description: Your exposure to the Feywild's magic grants you the following benefits:

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Fey Magic
benefits.description: You always have the Misty Step spell prepared. You also choose one level 1 spell from the Divination or Enchantment school, which you always have prepared. You can cast each of these spells once without expending a spell slot per Long Rest. You can also cast them using spell slots. The spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Punch and Grab
benefits.description: When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike (Attack action), you can use both the Damage and the Grapple options.

benefits.name: Attack Advantage
benefits.description: You have Advantage on attack rolls against a creature Grappled by you.

benefits.name: Fast Wrestler
benefits.description: You don't have to spend extra movement to move a creature Grappled by you if the creature is your size or smaller.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Strength score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Heavy Weapon Mastery
benefits.description: When you hit a creature with a Heavy weapon (Attack action), deal extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

benefits.name: Hew
benefits.description: After a Critical Hit or reducing a creature to 0 HP with a Melee weapon, you can make one attack with the same weapon as a Bonus Action.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Armor Training
benefits.description: You gain proficiency with Heavy armor.

benefits.description: Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Damage Reduction

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Bolstering Performance
benefits.description: After a Short or Long Rest, give an inspiring performance for up to six allies within 30ft. Each gains Temp HP equal to your Level + ability modifier increased by this feat.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase

benefits.name: Quick Study

benefits.name: Concentration Breaker

benefits.name: Guarded Mind
benefits.description: If you fail an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw, you can cause yourself to succeed instead.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Weapon Proficiency
benefits.description: You gain proficiency with Martial weapons.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Dexterous Wearer
benefits.description: While wearing Medium armor, you can add 3, rather than 2, to your AC if your Dexterity is 16 or higher.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Armor Training
benefits.description: You gain proficiency with Medium armor.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Wisdom score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Mounted Strike
benefits.description: While mounted, you have Advantage on attack rolls against any unmounted creature within 5ft that is at least one size smaller than your mount.

benefits.name: Leap Aside
benefits.description: If your mount makes a Dexterity save for half damage, it takes no damage on success and half on failure while you are riding it and neither are Incapacitated.

benefits.name: Veer
benefits.description: While mounted and not Incapacitated, you can force an attack that hits your mount to hit you instead.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Keen Observer
benefits.description: Gain proficiency in one of the listed skills. If already proficient, gain Expertise instead.

benefits.name: Quick Search
benefits.description: You can take the Search action as a Bonus Action.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Puncture
benefits.description: Once per turn when you hit with Piercing damage, you can reroll one damage die and must use the new roll.

benefits.name: Enhanced Critical
benefits.description: When you score a critical hit with Piercing damage, roll one additional damage die for the extra damage.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Dexterity or Intelligence score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Potent Poison
benefits.description: When you make a damage roll that deals Poison damage, it ignores Resistance to Poison damage.

benefits.name: Brew Poison
benefits.description: Gain proficiency with Poisoner's Kit. Craft PB doses for 50 GP (1 hour work). Apply as a Bonus Action; lasts 1 min or until damage dealt. Target makes Con save or takes 2d8 Poison damage and is Poisoned until end of your next turn.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Pole Strike
benefits.description: After an Attack action with a Quarterstaff, Spear, or Heavy Reach weapon, use a Bonus Action to make a melee attack (1d4 Bludgeoning) with the opposite end.

benefits.name: Reactive Strike
benefits.description: While holding a Quarterstaff, Spear, or Heavy Reach weapon, use a Reaction to make a melee attack against a creature that enters your reach.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase one ability score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Saving Throw Proficiency
benefits.description: You gain saving throw proficiency with the chosen ability.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Ritual Spells
benefits.description: Choose level 1 ritual spells equal to your PB. You always have them prepared and can cast them with slots. Add another whenever your PB increases.

benefits.name: Quick Ritual
benefits.description: Cast a prepared Ritual spell using its regular casting time without using a spell slot.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Guardian
benefits.description: Immediately after a creature within 5ft of you Disengages or hits a target other than you, you can make an Opportunity Attack against them.

benefits.name: Halt
benefits.description: When you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, their Speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn.

feats.name: Shadow Touched
feats.description: Your exposure to the Shadowfell's magic grants you the following benefits:

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Shadow Magic
benefits.description: You always have the Invisibility spell prepared. You also choose one level 1 spell from the Illusion or Necromancy school, which you always have prepared. You can cast each of these spells once without expending a spell slot per Long Rest. You can also cast them using spell slots. The spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Dexterity score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Bypass Cover
benefits.description: Your ranged attacks with weapons ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.

benefits.name: Firing in Melee
benefits.description: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

benefits.name: Long Shots
benefits.description: Attacking at long range doesn't impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Strength score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Shield Bash
benefits.description: If you hit with a Melee weapon (Attack action) while holding a Shield, you can bash the target. They must make a Strength save or be pushed 5ft or knocked Prone.

benefits.name: Interpose Shield
benefits.description: If you make a Dexterity save for half damage while holding a Shield, use a Reaction to take no damage on a success.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Skill Proficiency
benefits.description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

benefits.name: Expertise
benefits.description: Choose one skill in which you have proficiency but lack Expertise. You gain Expertise with that skill.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Dexterity score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Blindsight
benefits.description: You have Blindsight with a range of 10 feet.

benefits.name: Fog of War
benefits.description: Gain Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made as part of the Hide action during combat.

benefits.name: Sniper
benefits.description: If you miss an attack roll while hidden, making the attack doesn't reveal your location.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Hamstring
benefits.description: Once per turn when you hit with Slashing damage, reduce the target's Speed by 10ft until the start of your next turn.

benefits.name: Enhanced Critical
benefits.description: When you score a critical hit with Slashing damage, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.description: Increase your Dexterity or Constitution score by 1 (max 20).

benefits.name: Speed Increase
benefits.description: Your Speed increases by 10 feet.

benefits.name: Dash over Difficult Terrain
benefits.description: When you take the Dash action, Difficult Terrain doesn't cost you extra movement for the rest of the turn.

benefits.name: Agile Movement
benefits.description: Opportunity Attacks have Disadvantage against you.

benefits.name: Warping Flesh
benefits.description: Immediately after you roll a 1 on a D20 Test, make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, you have the Stunned condition until the end of your next turn.

feats.name: Echoing Soul
feats.description: You experience echoes from a past or alternate life, gaining the following features:

benefits.name: Channelled Prowess
benefits.description: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice. Additionally, gain Expertise in one proficient skill; you can change this Expertise choice after a Long Rest.

benefits.name: Inherent Tongues
benefits.description: You know one additional language of your choice.

benefits.name: Intrusive Echoes
benefits.description: Immediately after you roll a 1 on a D20 Test, make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, you are Incapacitated until the end of your next turn and your Speed is halved.

feats.name: Gathered Whispers
feats.description: You are haunted by a cacophony of whispering spirits only you can hear. You gain the following features:

benefits.name: Spirit Whispers
benefits.description: Learn Message (no Material components). Always have Augury prepared; cast once per Long Rest without a slot or components, or use available slots.

benefits.name: Unearthly Scream
benefits.description: When hit by an attack, use a Reaction to add your PB to your AC against that attack.

benefits.name: Voices from Beyond
benefits.description: Immediately after rolling a 1 on a D20 Test, make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you are Deafened until the end of your next turn and have Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

feats.name: Living Shadow
feats.description: The shadow you cast is animate and ever-present, sometimes acting on its own will. You gain the following features:

benefits.name: Grasping Shadow
benefits.description: Learn Mage Hand (no components).

benefits.name: Lengthened Strike
benefits.description: Increase reach of a melee attack (Attack or Magic action) by 10ft.

benefits.name: Ominous Will

rows.result: You don't take any action or a Bonus Action, and you use all your movement to move. Roll 1d4 for the direction 1, north: 2, east; 3, south; 4, west.
You don't move or take a Bonus Action, and you take the Attack action to make one melee attack against a random creature within reach. If none are within reach, you take no action.
You have the Prone condition, and your turn ends.

benefits.description: After rolling a 1 on a D20 Test, make a Wisdom save or be Incapacitated until your next turn. Then, determine your behavior by rolling 1d8 on the Shadow's Will table.

feats.name: Mist Walker
feats.description: You know how to slip through the Mists, but if you remain in one area for too long, the Mists drain your life force. You gain the following features:

benefits.name: Domain Traveler
benefits.description: When entering the Mists, you are treated as if you have a Mist talisman for your destination domain (must know the name).

benefits.name: Mist Walk
benefits.description: When you take damage or fail a save vs Grappled/Restrained, use a Reaction to teleport up to 15ft.

benefits.name: Poisoned Roots
benefits.description: After a Long Rest, the area within 10 miles leeches your vitality. Short Rests in this area require a Constitution save or grant no benefits.

feats.name: Second Skin
feats.description: There is another side of you that most people never see. You gain the following features:

benefits.name: Alternate Form
benefits.description: Always have Alter Self prepared. Cast once per Long Rest without a slot or components; this casting doesn't require Concentration. Can also use available slots.

benefits.name: Involuntary Change

options: Seeing a particular phase of the moon
Smelling the scent of a certain type of flower
Touching pure silver with your bare skin
Seeing someone who resembles a specific individual

benefits.description: A specific catalyst triggers your change. After experiencing it, make a Charisma save or cast Alter Self without a slot. If already used, you are Stunned instead.

feats.name: Symbiotic Being
feats.description: A second being resides within your body, offering knowledge and assistance while furthering its own agenda. You gain the following features:

benefits.name: Entwined Existence
benefits.description: The symbiote can't be targeted. If you die, so does your symbiote. If you are returned to life, your symbiote also revives.

benefits.name: Second Mind
benefits.description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice from the provided list and know one additional language.

benefits.name: Sustained Symbiosis
benefits.description: When you fail a saving throw, you can take a Reaction and expend one of your Hit Dice. Roll the die and add the number rolled to the saving throw.

benefits.name: Symbiotic Agenda
benefits.description: Immediately after you roll a 1 on a D20 Test, make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, you have the Charmed condition for 1d12 hours and must follow the symbiote's commands. Repeat save on damage.

feats.name: Touch of Death
feats.description: Deathly power resides within you, bursting out at the slightest provocation. You gain the following features:

benefits.name: Death Touch
benefits.description: Learn Chill Touch (no components). Necrotic damage you deal with this spell ignores Resistance.

benefits.name: Pull of the Grave
benefits.description: You have Disadvantage on Death Saving Throws.

feats.name: Watchers
feats.description: Something unnatural is always watching you, taking the form of scurrying vermin and other eerie creatures. You gain the following features:

benefits.name: Borrowed Eyes
benefits.description: Always have Beast Sense and Speak with Animals prepared. Cast each once per Long Rest without a slot, or use available slots.

benefits.name: Heightened Suspicion
benefits.description: Add 1d4 to ability checks made as part of the Search action.

benefits.name: Incessant Watchers
benefits.description: Disadvantage on saves against Scrying. Additionally, after rolling a 1 on a D20 Test, make a Wisdom save or have Disadvantage on D20 Tests for 1 minute (repeat save at end of turns).

feats.name: Child of the Sun
feats.description: You are blessed by the morning light. You learn the *Faerie Fire* spell and can cast it once per Long Rest without a spell slot. Additionally, you and allies within 10 feet of you have Advantage on saving throws against being Blinded.

feats.name: Shadowmoor Hexer
feats.description: You possess the dark magic of the fens. You learn the *Hex* spell and can cast it once per Long Rest without a spell slot. When a creature you have hexed deals damage to you, you can use your Reaction to deal 1d6 Psychic damage to that creature.

feats.name: Tireless Reveler
feats.description: Your spirit is unyielding in celebration. When an ally within 60 feet uses Heroic Inspiration, you can use your Reaction to gain Heroic Inspiration yourself. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

feats.name: Vampire Hunter
feats.description: You have trained to resist the children of the night. You have Advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the Charmed condition, and you have Resistance to Necrotic damage.

feats.name: Vampire's Plaything
feats.description: You were once the thrall of a vampire. You have Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saving throws against being Poisoned. Additionally, you can speak, read, and write Abyssal or Infernal (your choice).

feats.name: Bloodlust
feats.description: You hunger for the life force of others. When you hit a creature that is missing any of its Hit Points with a melee attack, you can deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage. Once per turn, when you reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points with a melee attack, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your level + your Constitution modifier.

feats.name: Bomber
feats.description: You are a master of explosives. When you use an item that deals damage in an area (like Alchemist's Fire or a bomb), you can double the radius of the effect. Additionally, you add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage dealt by such items.

feats.name: Treacherous Allure
feats.description: Your beauty is a weapon. You learn the *Charm Person* spell and can cast it once per Long Rest without a spell slot. You have Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that is currently Charmed by you.

feats.name: Vampire Touched
feats.description: The shadow of vampirism hangs over you. You learn the *Spider Climb* spell and can cast it once per Long Rest without a spell slot. Additionally, you can move across vertical surfaces and along ceilings while leaving your hands free.

feats.name: Mark of Detection
feats.description: The Mark of Detection grants powers of observation and intuition. You gain a 1d4 bonus to Investigation and Insight checks. You always have *Detect Magic* and *Detect Poison and Disease* prepared, and you can cast each once per Long Rest without a spell slot.

feats.name: Mark of Making
feats.description: The Mark of Making grants power over artifice and industry. You gain a 1d4 bonus to Arcana and ability checks with artisan's tools. You know the *Mending* cantrip, and you always have *Magic Weapon* prepared (castable once per Long Rest for free).

feats.name: Fey Pact
feats.description: You have forged a pact with a powerful fey. You gain Resistance to Psychic damage. You learn the *Misty Step* spell and can cast it once per Long Rest without a spell slot. You also gain proficiency in Persuasion.

feats.name: Infernal Pact
feats.description: You have forged a pact with a powerful fiend. You gain Resistance to Fire damage. You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet; if you already have Darkvision, its range increases by 30 feet. This Darkvision can see through magical darkness.
